basic_filter.desc: The Basic Filter will maintain acceptable water quality on small tanks.
basic_heater.desc: The Basic Heater will keep the water at tropical temperatures on small tanks.
combi_mini.desc: The Combi Mini provides combined heating and filtering, saving you space and maintenance, but is only suitable for the smallest of tanks.
power_filter.desc: The Power Filter will maintain acceptable water quality on medium tanks.
power_heater.desc: The Power Heater will keep the water at tropical temperatures on medium tanks.
basic_pump.desc: The Basic Pump allows you to locate your equipment remotely from a tank for convenient access and to keep equipment out of the way of the Guests.
power_combi.desc: The Power Combi provides combined heating and filtering, saving you space and maintenance. It is suitable for small to medium sized tanks.
18_tanklight.desc: Provides basic level lighting for less demanding corals.
basic_skimmer.desc: The Protein Skimmer provides additional filtering power and is useful for maintaining higher water qualities on small tanks.
large_filter.desc: The Large Filter will maintain acceptable water quality on large tanks.
large_heater.desc: The Large Heater will keep the water at tropical temperatures on large tanks.
basic_chiller.desc: The Basic Chiller will keep the water at coldwater temperatures on small and medium tanks.
power_light.desc: Provides moderate level lighting for moderately demanding corals.
power_pump.desc: The Power Pump has a longer range and allows you to connect two tanks so they share the same equipment.
large_skimmer.desc: The Large Protein Skimmer provides additional filtering power and is useful for maintaining higher water qualities on medium tanks.
large_chiller.desc: The Large Chiller will keep the water at coldwater temperatures on large tanks.
double_filter.desc: The Double Filter provides combined filtering and skimming to maintain higher water qualities on smaller tanks with a single piece of equipment.
nitrate_reactor.desc: The Nitrate Reactor removes excess nitrates allowing for water quality high enough for sensitive species in medium tanks.
mega_heater.desc: The Mega Heater will keep the water at tropical temperatures on huge tanks.
large_nitrate_reactor.desc: The Large Nitrate Reactor removes excess nitrates allowing for water quality high enough for sensitive species in large tanks.
mega_chiller.desc: The Mega Chiller will keep the water at coldwater temperatures on huge tanks.
large_double_filter.desc: The Large Double Filter provides combined filtering and skimming to maintain higher water qualities on medium tanks with a single piece of equipment.
triple_filter.desc: The Triple Filter provides combined filtering, skimming and nitrate reacting to maintain very high water qualities on medium tanks with a single piece of equipment.
large_pump.desc: The Large Pump has a longer range and can connect to even more tanks, allowing you to take advantage of economies of scale and reduced maintainance requirements.
large_light.desc: Provides high level lighting for more demanding corals.
uv_steriliser.desc: The UV Steriliser removes pathogens from the water allowing the most sensitive species to be kept in smaller tanks.
mega_double_filter.desc: The Mega Double Filter provides combined filtering and skimming for huge tanks.
calcium_reactor.desc: The Calcium Reactor doses the water with calcium, increasing the growth rate of all corals within the system.
large_triple_filter.desc: The Large Triple Filter provides combined filtering, skimming and nitrate reacting to maintain very high water qualities on larger tanks with a single piece of equipment.
large_uv_steriliser.desc: The Large UV Steriliser removes pathogens from the water allowing the most sensitive species to be kept in medium tanks.
mega_nitrate_reactor.desc: The Mega Nitrate Reactor removes excess nitrates allowing for water quality high enough for sensitive species in larger tanks.
mega_light.desc: Provides ultra level lighting for the most demanding corals.
auto_feeder.desc: Once you've chosen the food type for it to dispense, the Auto-Feeder will release the correct amount of food into the connected tank, at the beginning of each day. Unfortunately the Auto-Feeder cannot dispense Supplements or food for animals which "Require Skill". These must be fed by hand.
mega_pump.desc: The Mega Pump has such a long range and high tank limit, that it's fathomable that an entire, small aquarium could be run on a single system with a Mega Pump at its center!
mega_uv_steriliser.desc: The Mega UV Steriliser removes pathogens from the water allowing the most sensitive species to be kept in larger tanks.
